cancelaciones.metaDescription: How to request a cancellation for a purchase on Boffmedia and under what conditions.
cancelaciones.title: Cancellation Policy
cancelaciones.lead: Since we only sell in-game items and online services for Minecraft, our cancellation policy is limited. However, we understand that exceptional situations may arise.

process.title: Cancellation Process
process.body1: If you encounter any issues with your purchase or need to request a cancellation, please contact our customer service through our contact page as soon as possible.

conditions.title: Cancellation Conditions
conditions.item1: The cancellation request must be made within 24 hours of purchase.
conditions.item2: The item or service must not have been used or activated.
conditions.item3: You must provide specific details about the issue found or the reason for cancellation.
conditions.item4: We reserve the right to investigate and resolve the cancellation request at our discretion.
conditions.fee: Please note that approved cancellations may be subject to a processing fee of 5% of the purchase value.

moreInfo.title: More Information
moreInfo.body1: For more information about refunds and disputes, please see our Disputes and Refunds Policy.

cookies.metaDescription: What cookies we use on Boffmedia and how to manage your preferences.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.lead: At Boffmedia we use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, personalize content and analyze traffic. This policy explains how we use them and how you can control them.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body1: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them on Boffmedia, and how you can manage your preferences. By using our website and services, you accept the use of cookies as described in this policy.

whatAre.title: What Are Cookies
whatAre.body1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet or mobile) when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember your preferences and actions over a period of time, so you don't have to re-enter them each time you visit.
whatAre.body2: Cookies can be first-party (set by the website you are visiting) or third-party (set by external domains). They can also be temporary (session) or persistent (remain on your device until deleted or expired).

types.title: Types of Cookies We Use
types.intro: At Boffmedia we use the following types of cookies to improve your experience:
types.essential: Essential cookies: necessary for the basic operation of the site. They enable navigation, login and access to secure areas. Without these cookies, the site cannot function properly.
types.preference: Preference cookies: allow us to remember your preferences, such as language, visual theme and accent color, to offer you a personalized experience.
types.analytics: Analytics cookies: help us understand how you interact with the site, which sections you visit and how we can improve. The information collected is aggregated and anonymous.
types.functionality: Functionality cookies: improve site performance by remembering decisions you make, such as keeping your session active or preserving recent tools.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.intro: Some external services we use may set their own cookies on your device:
thirdParty.analytics: Analytics providers: we use anonymous analytics tools to understand site usage and improve our services.
thirdParty.social: Social media: social sharing buttons may set cookies to track your interaction with them.
thirdParty.payments: Payment services: external payment processors may use cookies necessary to process transactions securely.
thirdParty.disclaimer: We have no control over third-party cookies. We recommend reviewing the privacy and cookie policies of each external service for detailed information.

management.title: Cookie Management
management.intro: You can manage and control cookies in the following ways:
management.browser: Browser settings: most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies from their settings. Check your browser's help section for more information.
management.tools: Specific tools: you can use online privacy tools to manage your cookie preferences centrally.
management.optOut: Analytics opt-out: some analytics providers offer opt-out plugins that you can install in your browser.
management.warning: Please note that if you block essential cookies, some parts of our site may not function properly or your experience may be affected.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body1: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in the cookies we use or for legal requirements. We will notify you of significant changes through the site or by email.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body1: If you have questions about our Cookie Policy, please contact us through our contact page.

devoluciones.metaDescription: Conditions, process and resolution of returns on Boffmedia.
devoluciones.title: Return Policy
devoluciones.lead: At Boffmedia, we strive to ensure that every purchase is a satisfying experience. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, we will review your case according to the criteria detailed below.

conditions.title: Return Conditions
conditions.item1: The request must be made within 7 calendar days from the date of purchase.
conditions.item2: The item or service must not have been used, activated or redeemed.
conditions.item3: You must verify the purchase with the receipt or order number.
conditions.item4: Items purchased on promotion or with special discount are excluded unless a verified defect is found.

process.title: Request Process
process.body1: To initiate a return, contact our team through the contact page indicating the order number and the detailed reason for the request. Our team will respond within a maximum of 48 business hours.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.body1: If the return is approved, the amount will be refunded via the original payment method within 7 business hours, and may be subject to a management fee of 5% of the purchase value.
resolution.body2: We reserve the right to reject requests that do not meet the above conditions or that are considered abusive.

moreInfo.title: More Information
moreInfo.body1: Also see our Cancellation Policy and our Disputes and Refunds Policy.

privacidad.metaDescription: How we collect, use and protect your personal information on Boffmedia.
privacidad.title: Privacy Policy
privacidad.lead: At Boffmedia we value and respect your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal information when you use our services.

info.title: Information We Collect
info.intro: We may collect the following types of information when you use our services:
info.registration: Registration information: username, email address and password.
info.profile: Profile information: avatar, biography and gaming preferences.
info.gameplay: Gameplay information: statistics, achievements and match history.
info.payments: Payment information: managed by secure payment processors.

usage.title: Use of Information
usage.services: Provide and improve our gaming services.
usage.transactions: Process transactions and send related notifications.
usage.communicate: Communicate with you about updates, offers and events.
usage.fraud: Prevent fraud and ensure the security of our services.

sharing.title: Sharing Information
sharing.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information in the following circumstances:
sharing.players: With other players, according to your profile settings.
sharing.providers: With service providers that help us operate the platform.
sharing.legal: If required by law or to protect our legal rights.

security.title: Data Security
security.body1: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, loss or alteration.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.object: Object to the processing of your information.
rights.withdraw: Withdraw your consent at any time.

cookies.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.body1: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve site functionality. You can manage your preferences through your browser settings.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body1: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes through the site or by email.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body1: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our contact page.

reembolsos.metaDescription: How we resolve disputes and manage refunds on Boffmedia.
reembolsos.title: Disputes and Refunds Policy
reembolsos.lead: At Boffmedia, we strive to provide the best possible experience for our customers. However, we understand that problems or misunderstandings may arise. This policy is designed to handle such situations fairly and efficiently.

disputeProcess.title: Dispute Process
disputeProcess.intro: If you have any issues with your purchase, follow these steps:
disputeProcess.item1: Contact our customer service through our contact page.
disputeProcess.item2: Provide all relevant details, including the order number and a detailed description of the issue.
disputeProcess.item3: Our team will investigate the issue and respond within 48 business hours.

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.intro: Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis, taking into account the following conditions:
refundPolicy.item1: The refund request must be made within 7 days of purchase.
refundPolicy.item2: The item or service must not have been substantially used or activated.
refundPolicy.item3: A valid reason for the refund must be provided.

refundProcess.title: Refund Process
refundProcess.item1: It will be processed via the original payment method within 7 business days.
refundProcess.item2: It may be subject to a processing fee of 5% of the purchase value.
refundProcess.disclaimer: We reserve the right to reject refund requests that do not comply with our policies or that are considered abusive.

moreInfo.body1: For more information about cancellations, please see our Cancellation Policy.
